name: Shillem
overview: Shillem, also known as Shallum, is identified in Scripture as a son of Naphtali, one of the twelve sons of Jacob. The genealogical records in Genesis 46:24 and 1 Chronicles 7:13 list him among Naphtali's sons, emphasizing his role within the tribal lineage. Numbers 26:49 further highlights his significance by naming a family, the Shillemites, descended from him, underscoring the continuation of his lineage within the nation of Israel.
